fullContentHtml:
UPSC NDA/ NA-II Result 2026 – Out – Full Details

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the Result for the post of National Defence Academy NDA & Naval Academy NA -II 2026 on the official website of UPSC. This recruitment was released for 394 posts. The online application process for UPSC NDA/ NA-II Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 20 May 2026, to 11 June 2026. The examination was held on 13 September 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UPSC NDA/ NA-II Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 20 May 2026
  • Last Date : 11 June 2026 (Extended)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 11 June 2026
  • Exam Date : 13 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 03 September 2026
  • Answer Key : 16 September 2026
  • Result Date : 09 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPSC NDA/ NA-II Result 2026 – Out?

UPSC NDA/ NA-II Result 2026 – Out is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
